name: Project: MONKE
summary:
Welcome to Project: MONKE.
This is a multiplayer PS1 themed monkey horror game! With graphics that really makes you feel like you’re playing a game from the early 2000’s! This game uses the same movement as the game Gorilla Tag (yes it’s pretty much a fangame) but beware, some might find this game… spoooookyy! Head down into the sewers with your friends and fix 16 pipes, to earn cool hats to look like a very funky monkey. But be cautious as there could be something that lurks down there..
